exposure: trial of labor after caesarean section (TOLAC)
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) success rate
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies, a history of only one previous CD with a low transverse incision, a viable fetus in cephalic presentation, and gestational age >32 weeks (N=1,546)
finding: The study found that nearly two-thirds of women with a history of cesarean delivery achieved VBAC, with previous vaginal birth and oxytocin use being positively associated with VBAC success.
mod_finding: Of 1,546 patients, 62.3% achieved VBAC while 37.7% had a secondary CD.
